summary: Lincoln County peak about five miles east of Alpine on the Bridger-Teton NF; listed as gone, and the Wyoming inventory files it among non-lookout sites, so a lookout is not confirmed.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. The Wyoming inventory files the site among non-lookout structures, so a regular fire lookout is not confirmed.

evidence.quote: If evidence or documentation is uncovered showing that any of these were actually used as regular wildland fire lookout sites, they will be moved to the lookout lists.

notes_for_editor: firelookout.com's page is headed as a fire lookout, while the Forest Fire Lookout Association inventory files the site among lookout sites and non-lookout structures with type unknown. The sources disagree and we did not settle it. Elevation 9292 ft (about 2,832 m) per firelookout.com; the record has none. Two searches found no build, staffing, access or removal history. Unverified lead: a 2003 Forest Service report, Lookouts, Latrines, and Lodgepole Cabins, cited by a Living New Deal entry for another Bridger-Teton lookout; it may not cover this peak.
